messages.subject_clean: error in DEB model of ectotherm function
messages.body_plain:
Dear NicheMapR users,

I just spotted an error that crept in to version 3 of NicheMapR's ectotherm model, whereby the egg batch buffer in the DEB model was filling faster than it should have been. It's now fixed. Apologies for any inconvenience caused.

All the best,
Mike
